scripts.generate-vapid: node -e "const wp=require('web-push');const k=wp.generateVAPIDKeys();console.log('VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY='+k.publicKey);console.log('VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY='+k.privateKey);console.log('\nAdd these to Netlify env vars:');console.log('netlify env:set VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY '+k.publicKey);console.log('netlify env:set VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY '+k.privateKey);console.log('netlify env:set VAPID_SUBJECT mailto:comercial@epiper.com.br')"
